source.captureMethod: logged-in in-app browser, visible UI navigation plus read-only DOM inspection
safetyBoundary: No product API was used as a primary data source.
No save, delete, terminate, copy confirmation, variable save, or upload submit was executed.
File input attributes, row text, hrefs, table text, and form values were read only.

dictionaryPolicy: This file describes product concepts, visible UI objects, live labels, and fixture implications for TAG_TOOL.
Executable action flows remain in action-contracts/*.json.
Current dev rows are opportunistic fixtures unless promoted in fixtures/requirements.json.

row overflow trigger with accessible label 更多操作

testImplications: Do not assume the list is empty in dev.
Empty-list cases require an isolated game/environment fixture.
Deleting or terminating any visible row is irreversible and requires explicit approval plus fixture ownership.

features.purpose: Create a calculated player tag from condition category, filter type, analysis period, and sub-tag grade ranges.
visibleSignals: page title 新增標籤
條件標籤 radio selected by default
fields 標籤名稱, 條件類別, 篩選類型, 分析時段, 備註, 子標籤級距
footer buttons 取消 and 儲存
validationText: 級距請由大到小排列（第一列為最高區間）
相鄰級距的數值須連貫，不可有空隙或重疊
每個子標籤至少需設定下限或上限其中之一
第 1 個子標籤請輸入子標籤名稱
testImplications: Numeric bound inputs currently default to 0; tests that expect blank initial bounds should be treated as PRD/live-UI drift until PM confirms expected behavior.
The first sub-tag remove button is disabled in the initial state.
Successful save creates data and is not a pure smoke action unless a temporary fixture policy is declared.

features.route: embedded in tag create and tag info pages
features.purpose: Select dynamic/static date ranges for condition tag analysis or tag info reading.
visibleSignals: opened from 分析時段 value such as 過去 7 天
section label 日期範圍
dynamic day inputs display 天前 suffix
footer buttons 取消 and 確定
testImplications: Rendered date text is date-dependent; assert labels and structural state instead of hardcoding the captured 2026/06/20 to 2026/06/26 range.
90-day range validation belongs to date-panel evidence and should not be inferred from backend data.

選擇檔案 button

The current live create tooltip still names 操作 even though older PRD drafts may describe add-mode as two-column CSV.

visibleSignals: title group 標籤資訊與每日資訊
sections 標籤基本設置 and 最新標籤值資訊

A case expects condition bound inputs to be blank but live UI defaults to 0.
classificationGuidance.classification: domain pack/spec drift or testcase expectation gap until PM confirms product requirement.

classificationGuidance.situation: Manual upload CSV guidance differs between PRD draft and live tooltip.
classificationGuidance.classification: domain pack/contract gap first; product bug only after current PRD oracle is confirmed.

classificationGuidance.situation: No chart or no daily table data appears on condition tag info with zero tagged users.
classificationGuidance.classification: not a product bug by itself; record empty-state evidence.
